verdict.rationale: Extend is API-first and fully usable without its dashboard. It has an official CLI with parse/extract/classify/split/workflows run/batch commands and an 'Output and scripting' section, plus Bearer-token API keys and official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Java and Go. For automation it adds async processing with SDK polling helpers and webhooks, and test-mode API keys that run in an isolated environment without touching production. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or running evals as a CI gate) and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CLI use.
